title: Paperwork, insurance and documents? <muted>We take care of that.</muted>

cmr.title: CMR consignment note
cmr.text: At collection we draw up the CMR, with the collection and delivery addresses and your vehicle’s details.

inspection.title: Inspection & photos
inspection.text: Your car is checked and photographed at collection. Existing damage is therefore recorded in black and white.

pod.title: POD on delivery
pod.text: On delivery, the recipient signs for receipt. You have proof that your car arrived safely.

insured.title: Insured transport
insured.text: Your vehicle is insured for the entire journey, from collection to delivery.

noHassle.title: You don’t have to arrange anything yourself
noHassle.text: No forms or admin for you. We take care of all the documents.
